hero.headline: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
hero.subhead: Emotional regulation. Specifically designed for dual-diagnosis care, DBT provides the tools needed for distress tolerance and interpersonal effectiveness, helping you manage intense emotions without drugs or alcohol.

image.alt: A calm, low-stimulation quiet room at Des Moines Wellness Center

sections.heading: What Dialectical Behavior Therapy involves
body: Dialectical Behavior Therapy was developed for people who experience emotion at high intensity, and it has become a central approach in dual-diagnosis treatment for exactly that reason. Where CBT asks what you are thinking, DBT focuses on what to do when the feeling is already overwhelming.

It is taught as a set of concrete skills across four areas — distress tolerance, emotional regulation, mindfulness and interpersonal effectiveness. The aim is a reliable alternative to substance use in the moments that previously left no other option.

items.title: Distress tolerance
items.text: Specific techniques for getting through an acute crisis without using, and without making the situation worse.

items.title: Emotional regulation
items.text: Work on recognising and naming emotional states early, before they reach the point of overwhelm.

items.title: Built for co-occurring conditions
items.text: DBT is a core part of our dual-diagnosis programming, not an optional extra.

sections.heading: Where it fits in your care
sections.subheading: Available at these levels of care. Most people move through more than one.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Skills groups and individual DBT work throughout the residential stay.

items.title: Intensive Outpatient (IOP)
items.text: Practising the skills in live situations while living at home.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis
items.text: The central modality where a co-occurring condition is being treated alongside addiction.

items.title: Aftercare & Alumni
items.text: Skills refreshers as part of ongoing alumni support.

sections.heading: Speak with our clinical team
body: Our intake specialists are available 24/7 for a confidential assessment. We can talk through which therapies fit your situation and verify your insurance on the same call.
